relay.advanced_help: Defaults suit most networks; change these only when a link needs it.
relay.auto_connect_trusted_help: Unknown peers never reconnect automatically. PIN pairing remains explicit.
relay.codec_help: Opus is recommended for network audio; PCM is useful for diagnostics.
relay.local_route_unavailable: No local audio endpoint is available yet.
relay.emitter_mode_hint: Choose a local source and send its audio to a trusted or discovered receiver.
relay.receiver_mode_hint: Receive peer audio and optionally monitor it on this device's default output.
relay.direction_switch_timeout: Direction peer did not acknowledge; reconnecting safely
relay.mobile_to_desktop_hint: The desktop listens for audio sent by the phone.
relay.discovery_help: Hosts announce over mDNS and are probed directly on USB tether links. After an explicit PIN pairing, a matching trusted peer may reconnect automatically; unknown peers never do. ADB forwarding is available explicitly, but is not discoverable.
relay.emitter_hint: Starting the host broadcasts this device's audio; receivers connect with your address and PIN.
relay.enrollment_accepted: Device trusted — future connections will be automatic
relay.enrollment_requested: Pairing request from {name} ({addr}) — accept to trust this device
relay.error_adb_requires_localhost: ADB transport requires localhost (127.0.0.1:48123) — run `adb reverse tcp:48123 tcp:48123` or `adb forward tcp:48123 tcp:48123` and set Host address to 127.0.0.1. Current target {target} is not loopback.
relay.error_no_route: No route to host — network changed or host unreachable
relay.no_links: No local IPv4 link detected; the QR and endpoint list stay empty until one appears.
relay.no_peers: No relay hosts found yet. Keep this panel open while the host advertises.
relay.pairing_help: A device wants to pair using your PIN. Check the name/address matches the device you expect, then Accept. PIN is shown in Host tab.
relay.pin_help: Six-digit PIN shared with the peer.
relay.port_help: TCP port; the discoverable application default is 48123. Explicit 0 selects an ephemeral port that USB probing cannot find.
relay.qr_hint: Scan with the Android app to fill in the address and PIN automatically.
relay.qr_no_link: No local IPv4 link detected; the QR appears as soon as one is available.
relay.qr_unavailable: No QR yet: start the host and make sure this device has a local IPv4 network link.
relay.quick_target_help: host:port, or a pasted qpw-relay:// QR payload.
relay.refresh_help: Search the network again for relay hosts
relay.start_host_first: Start the relay host before showing its QR code
relay.target_help: Use host:port, for example 192.168.1.20:48123, or paste a qpw-relay:// QR payload.
relay.title: Audio relay
relay.transport_help: Auto selects USB tether, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth PAN, then LAN. A prior PIN pairing enables trusted auto-connect for that peer; ADB forwarding uses an explicit localhost TCP tunnel.
relay.trusted_connection_rejected: Trusted connection was rejected. Pair with the host PIN again.
relay.unavailable: Audio relay requires the native PipeWire backend.
relay.windows_endpoint_help: Windows relays use loopback capture and playback on the selected endpoints; they do not create a microphone device.
